================================================================================
Deferred long keyword whose prefix is a higher-precedence keyword
================================================================================
:alpha
---
(program (long_keyword))

================================================================================
Deferred long keyword where it conflicts with a longer token
================================================================================
!alpha
---
(program (long_keyword))

================================================================================
Short keyword
================================================================================
?a
---
(program (short_keyword))

================================================================================
Keyword spellings are identifiers in identifier position
================================================================================
alpha
---
(program (identifier))
